Great sushi and rolls in Nha Trang
Aug 2024 • Family
Thought I'd leave a review because there are very few recent reviews of Japanese/sushi restaurants in Nha Trang.
I really liked it here. Good choice of sushi, rolls, all food fresh. Portions are not small, standard 8-piece rolls. There are interesting roll options, not like in Yatoria or Tanuki (in Moscow), but there are also classics (Philadelphia, unagi).
Prices are also reasonable, dinner for three (with a bottle of sake wine 300 ml. and soft drinks) - 1 million dong., which is roughly the rate of the Russian Federation on August 5, 2024 - 4 thousand rubles.
I would also like to note the decoration of the restaurant - very authentic, Japanese style, with sliding doors, sitting as if on the floor, squatting, but not quite))
Courteous and prompt service.
I recommend it.

I might be overly harsh but
Feb 2023 • Solo
The food per se wasn't the problem, it were comparable to similarly priced sushi restaurants in HCMC, but other things. First, I came in pretty early in the evening and there weren't many guests yet; but they were already out of tamago yaki (rolled eggs), a dish which was often used as a test dish. And the AC suddenly leaked and pour water straight on the walkway, they didn't bother to check if nearby guests got splashed wet and just said the AC ran too cold and leaked. And finally they charged for the wet wipe, which is common for Vietnamese restaurants, but most other places would offer dry paper tissues, and most decent Japanese restaurants in Vietnam would not charge for this. I might be overly harsh with this review but I tend to hold Japanese restaurants to a higher standard, as I would hold French restaurants to higher standards than similarly priced American ones
